# Account Hub calendar discovery checks skip state around work and registers selected results

Range-scoped production caller, not full email.mjs certification. Forward-action
branches:1219–1296 call #fetchSyncAccounts after account creation and later
#addSyncAccounts for selected form state. #fetchSyncAccounts:1888–2006 starts
loading and an AbortController. It tries the email domain and incoming host when
same effective site, also Graph host when applicable. Address-book discovery
finishes first. It checks abort, waits an abortable1s pause, then awaits calendar
discovery; checks abort again, clears controller and displays results/success.
This delay is an explicit chance to skip, not a recommended generic test delay.

#getCalendars:2231–2279 sequentially tries HTTPS hostnames with current email,
password, remember-password and auth method. It catches/logs individual failures,
stops at a nonempty provider Map, flattens arrays and marks existing URIs with
{name,existing:true}. It does not pass its AbortSignal into detection.detect.
Thus skip checks suppress later result display while detector/network work can
continue until its own completion. Network cancellation during calendar discovery
is unresolved; it is not proved by the caller's AbortController field.

#handleAbortable:500–523 aborts controller with UserSkippedError without clearing
it immediately, stops loading, and rejects a pending redirect in the separate
email discovery stream. That email-stream cleanup is not a demonstrated calendar
request cancellation. reset:2438 onward calls it before clearing UI state.
#fetchSyncAccounts catch treats UserSkippedError as success notification;
other failures show no-sync-accounts info. It records completion telemetry and
stops loading. #addSyncAccounts:2290–2298 synchronously registers selected calendars
and creates selected address books. If a later registration/create fails, the
read body has no rollback of earlier registered objects.

Direct browser sync-accounts test was read in full519 lines. test_skip_sync_accounts_load
clicks Skip after password/account setup and waits for success view; it does not
directly assert an in-flight CalDAV channel cancelled. The second task checks two
detected calendar labels, selection count/Fluent changes, selecting one, and
onCalendarRegistered callback with manager-observer removal. It asserts selected
calendar name/type and telemetry reporting two discovered calendars, distinct
from one registered selection. This directly checks a registration chain. The
form implementation remains a separate source scope; selection DOM tests execute
it without a full body certification here. No browser tests ran in this pass.

## Evidence scope

Thunderbird `87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799`; Firefox `1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b`. Paths and line ranges or named task anchors
refer to these exact commits. Read with `git show REVISION:repository-relative-path`.
Direct source relationships, inferred effects and unresolved dispatch are separated.
Static test assertions do not establish a pass. Product run results identify the
observed build and its unknown native revision. Private logs, indexes and local
paths stay outside shared knowledge. Suite and deliberate instructions are unchanged.
